snippet.title: Enshrined: Sword of Fates
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835610/Enshrined_Sword_of_Fates/

“Two souls must join in body and spirit to activate its power. Act quickly, insects… Time is running short.”

Enshrined: Sword of Fates is the latest title by Truant Pixel’s Souha Al-Samkari, creator of Akash: Path of the Five, senior writer on Date Everything and First Bite.  It is a dark fantasy visual novel that dares to ask the question “what if an ancient, powerful sword of legend could only be activated by sleeping with someone… and your only choices were three strangers who were just trying to kill you?” 

Strap in for the world’s worst date with three men who should be nowhere near the dating pool: 

DYMA: A proud king who is as muscular as he is entitled (VERY). 
NIKO: A mercenary quick on the draw with his sword and his mouth.
JUN: A mysterious adventurer who’s frighteningly competent and maddeningly tight-lipped.

Enshrined features a silent main character with customizable name and pronouns, along with three distinct character backgrounds that each have their own unique dialogue across all routes.

JYNDI: A humanoid race known for their pointed ears and their ability to survive in harsh climates, such as mountains and deserts.

FALLEN: Angels who have been forcibly freed of their celestial bonds in the heavens and banished by their divine masters.

HUMAN: What humans lack in natural strength they make up in an aptitude for magical study compared to Fallen and Jyndi. 

Enshrined is fully-voiced by an all-star cast. Starring:

SungWon Cho (Borderlands 3, God of War: Ragnarok, Date Everything!) as Jun 
Dave Fennoy (The Walking Dead, Batman: Arkham Knight, Minecraft: Story Mode) as Dyma 
Jonah Scott (Dying Light 2, Date Everything!, When the Night Comes)  as Niko 

Each route features a collectable CG, bonus art, and multiple bad ends–after all, picking which man you’re going all the way with is just the beginning.

Enshrined will be featured in Steam Next Fest October 13-20th, and is set to release Fall 2025.

#indiegame #indiedev #visualnovel
